issues.description: The template's detect_errors function has a return type annotation of list[int], but the problem statement and the solution expect and document an ndarray (npt.NDArray[np.int8]). This mismatch between the template signature and the specification/solution can confuse students about the expected return type and lead to type-related mistakes when implementing or testing the function.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template function signature to match the problem specification and solution by changing the return annotation from list[int] to npt.NDArray[np.int8], and ensure the docstring and examples consistently state that an ndarray of dtype int8 is returned (with 1 meaning 'no error detected').
